framework: Andrews-Todd & Kerr (2019) CPS ontology — chat-message subskills
note: Definitions paraphrased from Andrews-Todd & Kerr (2019) and examples from Zhu et al. (2026), Table 3. Refine definitions against the original ontology before formal use.

CRF.name: Representing and formulating
CRF.definition: Building a mental representation of the problem: stating what the problem requires, formulating hypotheses about the task, or articulating how the problem is structured.
examples: I think we still have to get to the correct voltage of each resistor.

CP.name: Planning
CP.definition: Proposing or developing a plan or strategy for solving the problem, including suggesting concrete next steps or goal values to try.
examples: Everyone try to make all of your resistors equal to 100 ohms.

CMC.name: Monitoring communication
CMC.definition: Communicating about the monitoring of one's own progress or system state: reporting whether things are working, correct, or on track.
examples: It keeps telling me mine's incorrect.

CEC.name: Executing communication
CEC.definition: Communicating about actions taken to execute the plan: reporting concrete manipulations or changes one has made.
examples: I got 325, I changed it to 330.

SESU.name: Establishing shared understanding
SESU.definition: Building common ground with teammates: proposing shared approaches, checking that others understand, or aligning the team on a joint view of the task.
examples: What if everyone sets there resistor to, let's say, 1k Ohms?

SMC.name: Maintaining communication
SMC.definition: Sustaining the social interaction without task content: acknowledgements, social niceties, encouragement, or off-task rapport talk.

SN.name: Negotiating
SN.definition: Expressing agreement, disagreement, or qualified positions on others' ideas; resolving differences of opinion.

SSI.name: Sharing information
SSI.definition: Sharing task-relevant information with teammates, such as one's own readings, values, or known constraints.
examples: I currently have 2.0 volts with a 180 ohm resistor.
